root_cause.text: In netfilter's nf_conncount list garbage-collection logic, the optimization to skip GC after one run per jiffy used only `last_gc` and a too-small cleanup budget, so when more than 8 connections were added in the same jiffy stale entries were not reclaimed fast enough and `list->count` could falsely hit the connection limit.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE/commit explicitly says “After the optimization to only perform one GC per jiffy… If more than 8 new connections are tracked per jiffy the list won't be cleaned up fast enough possibly reaching the limit wrongly,” and the patch fixes this by adding `last_gc_count`, gating GC skipping on `(list->count - list->last_gc_count) < CONNCOUNT_GC_MAX_COLLECT`, and increasing the collection limit from 8 to 64.
